message.content:
Northbank community garden will close its north gate on Saturday, April 18, from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm. Plumbers are repairing a leaking water pipe near that entrance during these hours. Gardeners must use the east entrance to access the plots. 

Because of the work, the annual seed swap will now take place on Sunday at 11:00 am. Bring your surplus heirloom seeds to exchange at the central pavilion. 

We need volunteers to assist with clearing the path around the repair site once the pipe is fixed. Mina is coordinating the volunteer shifts for Saturday afternoon and Sunday morning. If you can help, contact Mina directly to sign up. 

Volunteers must bring their own work gloves for safety. The garden will supply all necessary shovels, rakes, and wheelbarrows. Thank you for your patience as we fix our irrigation system.
